LanguageData.GR_GoauldQueenHarvestImmatureSymbioteDes: Extract one physical immature Prim'ta symbiote from this player-controlled Goa'uld queen. The queen needs three RimWorld days before another extraction, and the resource must then be matured in a Prim'ta incubation basin with raw meat nutrients.
